zh: 两个人都默认刚才那半秒不存在。Roman坐回去，Adrian也坐下，只有呼吸还没完全恢复。
桌上的继承平板自己亮了：需要二次身份认证。
“听着就很侵犯隐私。”第一题弹出来：Adrian真正紧张的时候会做什么？
Adrian低头。自己的右手果然搭在左手腕上。连他自己都没察觉的小动作，Roman隔了十年还记得。

zh.hint: 认证要求双方作答。下一题，轮到你答他的事。

win.title: MATCH 92%
win.txt: 一个人不会无意间把另一个人记得这么细。

win: 剩下那8%，是我不在的那几年。
lose: 系统停在一个不上不下的数字上。Roman看了一眼，没说话。
可他答的那几道，一道都没错。

zh.hint: 认证结束后，屏幕上多出一个入口：情侣问答。三个私密问题，可以答，也可以跳过。

opts.t: 你最想念什么？
then: 你骂我的时候。没人敢那样跟我说话。

opts.t: 那天晚上，谁先移开视线的？
Adrian点了跳过。
then: Roman看着那个跳过键，像松了口气，又像有点失望。

zh: 界面又跳出一段动画：欢迎礼遇，个人礼物额度。
“你这么一说，我就一定要管了。”
礼物页第一件就是四万美元的表。昨天他绝不会点开，今天系统推荐得像推荐一杯咖啡。
可Roman不像会被价格打动的人。他想看Roman高兴——这个念头来得太自然，非常不方便。

zh.title: 猜他想要的礼物
zh.hint: 最贵的不一定最对。你还记得他多少？

then: Roman把衬衫袖口拉高。Adrian替他扣表带，指腹擦过他腕骨，皮肤很热。
“我知道。”Adrian按紧扣环才抬眼，“只是想看看戴你身上好不好看。”
Roman看了一眼封面，手指停在书脊上。
他翻开扉页，那里有十七岁的他写的名字。他合上书，很久没说话。
“你连我紧张摸手腕都知道。扯平。”
Roman把订阅卡收进内袋，靠心口那一侧。
Roman把袖扣举到灯下看了很久，目光却落在桌上那枚Vale袖扣上。
同一个工匠。你从哪儿订的？
Roman愣了一下，像从没想过自己还有不工作的时候。

zh: Roman从口袋里摸出一个旧钥匙扣，放进Adrian掌心。金属被磨得发亮。

zh.title: 回忆：他从没扔掉的钥匙扣

zh: Adrian正想问他到底留了多久，手机震了。金色通知盖住整个屏幕：未婚夫抵达——18:00。
他的视线从“未婚夫”慢慢移到Roman脸上。Roman表情没变，只有刚才扣表带的那只手停住了。

zh.hint: 一个突然冒出来的未婚夫。比未婚夫更有意思的，是Roman的反应。

opts.t: 帅吗？

then.hint: “帅吗？”他就是故意的。你知道他在看你怎么答。

opts.t: 不重要。
比我差。
then: Adrian愣了一秒，笑出声：“你刚才说什么？”

opts.t: Roman把手机屏幕按灭。“我会查清楚他是谁。”
我结婚的话，安保也归你管？
then: 我负责让他活着走出你家门。

opts.t: Adrian什么都没问，只盯着Roman停住的那只手。

zh: 前舱有人叫他确认落地安保。他起身走了两步，又回头。
你六岁的时候还更听话。
桌角，Roman的加密手机亮了一下。照片缩略图一闪而过——是十七岁的Adrian。
理智说不该看。另一半脑子说：他秘密看了你三年。公平突然变成一个很方便的词。

zh.hint: 他在前舱，手机没锁屏。你大概只有一分钟。

items: 如果他回到Vale家，就说明你失败了。

apps.lockTxt: 需要密码。提示：便利店那晚的日期。
items: 十七岁的Adrian和Roman坐在便利店门口。照片里的Adrian还没学会带刺的笑，Roman也还没学会把情绪藏起来。
保存于十年前。此后每年同一天，被打开过一次。
我应该在今天之前就告诉他。
未发送 · 三年前 / 一年前 / 昨天
导航记录 · 布鲁克林某便利店 · 41次

win: 他把手机放回原位，角度分毫不差。
他留着那张照片，整整十年。
比照片更危险的是那条草稿：他不是没想过回来，只是一次又一次没回来。
lose: Adrian只看了一眼就把手机扣回桌上。心跳比偷看本身还响。
可那张十七岁的缩略图，已经印在他眼睛里了。
skip: Adrian把手机推回原位，没碰。有些事，他想听Roman亲口说。

zh: 前舱门开了，Roman回来。桌上的手机角度没变，屏幕亮度却不对。

zh.hint: 他看过你的手机了。他把它放得很仔细——仔细得像心虚。

opts.t: Roman和他对视了一秒，什么都没问。
我的手机好看吗？
Roman拿起手机，当着他的面改了密码。
then: 四个数字。Adrian认得——便利店那晚的日期。

zh: Adrian正要开口，Roman的手机自己亮了。未知号码，语音消息，00:06。

zh.title: 语音消息 · 未知号码

zh: Roman整个人的气质变了。不是害怕，是进入工作状态。他关掉语音的速度太快。
快得更像是不想让Adrian听见。人藏信息有两种原因：怕伤到自己，或者怕伤到你。

zh.hint: 他把语音关了。你甚至没听清那个声音是谁。

opts.t: 再放一遍。
它叫你Cross。它认识你。
Adrian伸手，覆住他握着手机的手。
then: Roman的手指僵了一下，没抽走。

t: “离他远点。”七年前也有人这么跟我说。上一次，我听了。

zh: 飞机开始下降。纽约的轮廓从云层下浮出来。
舱门打开以后，站我左边。
因为外面有四十七张媒体证。
门开了。闪光灯先冲进来，喊声和快门声混成一片。三小时前，他还是没人认识的上班族。
Roman向前半步挡在他侧前方，一只手落到他后腰。不是轻扶，是扣住。

zh.hint: 四十七台镜头。你的手扣在他后腰，这个位置不在任何安保手册里。

opts.t: （俯身到他耳边）走左边。贴紧我。
Roman把手从他后腰移到肩上，换成标准的护送姿势。
then: 隔着一层布料，Adrian反而觉得那只手太规矩了。

opts.t: （贴着他耳后）别回头。你一回头，明天头条就是你的脸。
then: 扣在后腰的手收紧了一点。

zh: 气息擦过耳后，Adrian的肩膀本能地绷了一下。
快门声里Adrian侧过脸，鼻尖几乎碰上：“你现在才问？”
“时机烂透了。”记者在喊：“你真的是秘密私生子吗？”“你已经订婚了吗？”

zh.title: 介入
zh.hint: 四十七台镜头，一个问题比一个狠。你要怎么站在这里？

then: Adrian只是笑了一下。那张笑脸，第二天上了六家网站的首页。
扣在他后腰的手松了一点点，像松了口气。
“我是Adrian Vale。”他对着最近的那支话筒说，“下一个问题。”
全场安静了一秒，然后快门声翻了一倍。
Roman低头看了他一眼，眼神很深。
“谁告诉你们我今天落地的？”最前排的记者一愣，下意识往人群后面看了一眼。
Roman顺着那道视线看过去，对耳机低声说了一句。

then.title: 线索：有人提前放了消息
then.txt: 落地时间，只有家族内部知道。

then: Adrian抓住Roman的手腕往身边一带。Roman愣了半秒，顺势站到他身侧。
闪光灯像炸开一样。这一张，明天会在所有人手机里。

zh.cap: 周三 12:41 · 舷梯上，他的手扣在你后腰
zh.prompt: Private jet stairs on a bright tarmac, dozens of camera flashes, a tall broad-shouldered man in a black suit with an earpiece shielding a slimmer dark-haired man in a tailored suit, his hand firmly at the smaller man's lower back, both in their late twenties, press crowd blurred in the foreground, cinematic, no text

zh: 车门终于把记者关在外面。手机开始失控地震，几十条，几百条。

zh.txt: Vale继承人现身，身边跟着神秘保镖。
cm: 这手放的位置也太离谱了。
他根本就是把人往自己怀里带。
没有保镖会这样看雇主。

zh: 放大后的照片比当时更暧昧。照片里的自己往Roman那边偏着，一点都不像想躲。
互联网认识他们才十一分钟，就已经比他们两个都坦诚。
Roman的动态更新了一张没有人的照片：酒店电梯的监控角度。配文：镜头太多了。

zh.hint: 你可以在他的动态下面留言。半个纽约都在看。

opts.t: 你特别注意哪一个？
then: 评论发出去三秒，私聊就弹了出来。

opts.t: Adrian给那条动态点了个赞，什么都没写。
then: 小红心刚亮，Roman的私聊就来了。

opts.t: Adrian把那张媒体照存进了私人相册。
then: 没发，没赞，只是存了下来。
对面的Roman正在检查路线，完全不知道。

en: They both agree, silently, that the last half second didn't happen. Roman sits. Adrian sits. Only their breathing hasn't caught up.
The inheritance tablet lights up on its own: SECONDARY IDENTITY VERIFICATION REQUIRED.
"That sounds invasive." The first question pops up: What does Adrian do when he is genuinely nervous?
Adrian looks down. His right hand is already on his left wrist. A habit he never noticed himself, and Roman still knows it ten years later.

en.hint: The check needs both of you. Next round, you answer about him.

qs.q: What fruit does Roman hate most?
After a fight, who apologizes first?
How does Roman take his coffee?

win.title: MATCH 92%
win.txt: You don't memorize someone like that by accident.

win: The missing eight is the years I wasn't there.
lose: The system lands on an in-between number. Roman glances at it and says nothing.
But every question he answered, he got right.
skip: Skip it. I know the answers.

en.hint: When the check is done, a new door appears: Couple Q&A. Three private questions. Answer or skip.

opts.t: What did you miss most?
then: You yelling at me. Nobody else ever dared.

opts.t: Who looked away first that night?
then: Roman's jaw sets. He doesn't argue.

opts.t: Adrian taps Skip.
then: Roman looks at the Skip button like he's relieved. And a little disappointed.

en: Another animation slides in: WELCOME BENEFIT / PERSONAL GIFT CREDIT.
The first item is a $40,000 watch. Yesterday he'd never have opened the page. Today it's recommended like a cup of coffee.
But Roman isn't someone a price tag impresses. He wants to see Roman happy. The thought comes so easily it's inconvenient.

en.title: Gift Guess
en.hint: The most expensive isn't the best. How much of him do you remember?

then: Roman pushes up his cuff. Adrian fastens the strap; his fingertips brush the wrist bone. Warm skin.
You know I can do that myself.
"I know." Adrian snaps the clasp before he looks up. "I wanted to see if it looked good on you."
Roman looks at the cover. His fingers stop on the spine.
He opens it. His name is on the flyleaf in a seventeen-year-old's handwriting. He closes it and doesn't speak for a while.
items.sub: The one he wore out at seventeen

then: "You know I touch my wrist when I'm nervous. We're even."
Roman tucks the card into his inside pocket, the side over his heart.
Roman holds them up to the light for a long time. His eyes keep going to the Vale cufflink on the table.
Same maker. Where did you order these?
I can't wear these on the job.
Roman blinks, like it never occurred to him he has an 'off the job.'
items.sub: For a man who's always listening

en: Roman takes an old keychain out of his pocket and puts it in Adrian's palm. The metal is worn shiny.

en.title: Memory: The Keychain He Never Threw Away

en: Adrian is about to ask how long, when his phone buzzes. A gold banner covers the screen: FIANCÉ ARRIVAL — 18:00.
His eyes travel from FIANCÉ to Roman's face. Roman's expression doesn't change. Only his hand stops.

en.hint: A fiancé out of nowhere. Roman's reaction is more interesting than the fiancé.

opts.t: Hot?

then.hint: "Hot?" He's doing it on purpose. You know he's watching how you answer.

opts.t: Irrelevant.
Not as good as me.
then: Adrian stares for a second, then laughs. "What did you just say?"
I said he lands at six.

opts.t: Roman switches his phone screen off. "I'll find out who he is."
then: "Checking him out, or guarding against him?"

opts.t: If I get married, are you running security for that too?
then: I'll make sure he leaves your building alive.

opts.t: Adrian doesn't ask anything. He just watches Roman's frozen hand.
then: Roman pulls the hand back and closes it into a fist.

en: Someone up front needs him to confirm landing security. He gets up, takes two steps, turns back.
On the corner of the table, Roman's encrypted phone lights up. A thumbnail flashes by. Adrian, at seventeen.
He shouldn't look. The other half of his brain says: he watched you for three years. Fairness is suddenly very convenient.

en.hint: He's in the front cabin and the screen is unlocked. You have maybe a minute.

items: He still doesn't know, does he?
How long are you going to keep this up?
If he comes home, you failed.

Saved ten years ago. Opened once a year since, on the same date.
I should have told him before today.

win: He puts the phone back exactly where it was, at exactly the same angle.
He kept that photo. For ten years.
The draft is worse than the photo. It means he thought about coming back. He just didn't, again and again.
lose: Adrian looks once and turns the phone face down. His heartbeat is louder than the snooping.
But the thumbnail of his seventeen-year-old face is already burned in.
skip: Adrian pushes the phone back without touching the screen. Some things he wants to hear from Roman.

en: The cabin door opens and Roman comes back. His phone is at the same angle. The screen brightness isn't.

en.hint: He's been through your phone. He put it back very carefully. Carefully enough to look guilty.

opts.t: Roman holds his eyes for a second and asks nothing.
Enjoy my phone?
then: Adrian doesn't blink. "Your passcode's too easy."
Roman stares at him for two seconds and lets it go.

opts.t: Roman picks up the phone and changes the passcode right in front of him.
then: Four digits. Adrian knows them. The date of the convenience-store night.

en: Adrian opens his mouth, and Roman's phone lights up on its own. Unknown number. Voice message, 00:06.
Something in Roman switches. Not fear. Work mode. He kills the message too fast.
Fast enough that it's about Adrian not hearing it. People hide things for two reasons: it can hurt them, or it can hurt you.

en.hint: He shut it off. You didn't even catch whose voice it was.

opts.t: Play it again.
It called you Cross. It knows you.
then: A lot of people know me.
"A lot of people tell you to stay away from me?"

opts.t: Adrian reaches over and covers the hand holding the phone.
then: Roman's fingers go still. He doesn't pull away.
"I didn't ask if you were fine."

t: 'Walk away.' Someone told me that seven years ago. Last time, I listened.

en: They start to descend. New York surfaces under the clouds.
When the door opens, stay on my left.
Because there are forty-seven press credentials outside.
The door opens. The flashes hit first, then the shouting and the shutters. Three hours ago, nobody knew his name.
Roman steps half a pace ahead and to the side, and his hand settles at the small of Adrian's back. Not resting. Holding.

en.hint: Forty-seven cameras. Your hand is on the small of his back, and no security manual puts it there.

opts.t: (at his ear) Left side. Stay close.
Roman moves his hand from Adrian's back to his shoulder. Textbook escort position.
then: Through the fabric, Adrian finds the hand almost too correct.

opts.t: (right at his ear) Don't turn around. Turn around and your face is tomorrow's front page.
then: The hand at his back tightens a little.

en: His breath catches the back of Adrian's ear. Adrian's shoulders tense.
In the storm of shutters Adrian turns his head; their noses nearly touch. "You're asking now?"
"Terrible timing." The press is shouting: "ARE YOU THE SECRET SON?" "ARE YOU ENGAGED?"

en.title: Step In as Adrian
en.hint: Forty-seven cameras, each question worse than the last. How do you stand here?

then: Adrian just smiles. By tomorrow, that smile is on six front pages.
The hand at his back eases a fraction, like Roman's relieved.
"I'm Adrian Vale," he tells the nearest mic. "Next question."
One second of silence. Then the shutters double.
Roman looks down at him, and it's a long look.
"Who told you I was landing today?" The front-row reporter freezes and glances, without meaning to, toward the back.
Roman follows the look and says something low into his earpiece.

then.title: Clue: Someone Tipped Them Off
then.txt: Only the family knew when he'd land.

then: Adrian takes Roman's wrist and pulls him level. Roman freezes for half a second, then steps in at his side.
The flashes explode. This one will be on every phone by morning.
(very low) You did that on purpose.

en.txt: Vale heir spotted with mystery bodyguard.

That is not how a bodyguard looks at a client.

en: Blown up, the photo is worse than the moment. He's leaning toward Roman in it. He doesn't look like he wants to get away.
The internet has known them for eleven minutes and is already less subtle than either of them.
Roman's feed updates: a photo with no people in it, a hotel elevator from the security camera's angle. Caption: Too many cameras.
